args.title: Fix file downloads in Safari by appending the temp link to the body
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Safari requires temporary download elements to be attached to the document body before clicking them. Append the anchor element to `document.body` before `link.click()` and remove it afterwards.
